## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] MCP tools or schemas
- [ ] Topic detection or context enrichment
- [ ] Agent routing or orchestration
- [ ] Context memory or vector storage
- [ ] Documentation only

## Verification

Commands run:

```sh
npm test
npm run lint
```

## Checklist

- [ ] Public docs match current behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, local configs, context memory dumps, vector data, generated logs, or session data are included.
- [ ] Package metadata and examples still use the published package name.
